junglee/Amazon-crawler: Use when you need Amazon product details or search/category results (title, price, ASIN, rating, reviews count) from product, search or category URLs.
delicious_zebu/ebay-product-listing-scra: Use when you need active eBay search results or category listings with price, condition, seller rating, shipping and sold count.
e-commerce/walmart-fast-product-scraper: Use when you need Walmart.com or Walmart.ca search or category results with price, availability, rating and seller.
epctex/google-shopping-scraper: Use when you need Google Shopping results for a query: product, price, merchant and reviews across stores.
piotrv1001/aliexpress-listings-scraper: Use when you need AliExpress search results with price, discount, rating and sales volume for a ship-to country.
autofacts/shopify: Use when you need the product catalog of a public Shopify store: variants, prices, SKUs and stock.
publicrecords/etsy-search-scraper: Use when you need what ranks on Etsy for a keyword, category or market page: position, price, rating, review count, Bestseller/Star Seller badges and whether the listing is an ad.
